name: Lesbianism
overview: Scripture clearly establishes that God created humanity as male and female, designed for complementary relationships (Matthew 19:4; Mark 10:6). The Old Testament explicitly declares same-sex relations, including those between women, as an abomination (Leviticus 18:22; 20:13). In the New Testament, God’s judgment is described upon those who abandon natural relations, including women exchanging natural use for unnatural passions (Romans 1:26). Thus, biblical teaching affirms the created order and condemns lesbianism as contrary to God’s design.
